I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the site is Pine Crossing.

The source is her own message in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could see only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead. Hollis replied that he would check the shift template and have support try to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

I couldn't find any later message in the channel saying it was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before marking it resolved. Pree can see #central-team herself.
